The person was fed up with the sister's attitude and decided to speak up, which can be a healthy way to handle the situation. On the other hand, the way they addressed it might have been confrontational. Telling someone that the world doesn't revolve around them can come off as dismissive or harsh, especially if the person is already sensitive. It might have escalated the situation rather than resolving it. Maybe a more constructive approach would have been to discuss the specific behaviors and how they affect the person, rather than making a general statement.
